name: com.ownyouragent/ownyouragent
title: OwnYourAgent
description: Read-only: services, prices, the open Ownership Check, our answers, comparison and trust register.

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: Returns the four OwnYourAgent services in phase order (AI opportunity report, first working pilot, implementation, management & support) with price model and amount in EUR excl. VAT (fixed, or an indicative min-max range), billing, deliverables, the seven outputs of the opportunity report, what is excluded, the price disclaimer and canonical Dutch and English URLs. usage.routing lists the situations where OwnYourAgent refers a buyer to another site instead (a contact centre, an organisation-wide project, AI literacy training), with the link to use. Prices are indicative for scoped projects, not quotes. Please cite the URL.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: nl (Dutch) or en (English). Omit to get both.

tools.name: get_approach
tools.description: Returns how OwnYourAgent works: the four phases (choose, test, put to work, improve; the client decides after every step), the four agreements put in writing before building (data location, what the agent may do, continuing without OwnYourAgent, the client owns the test set) and the way of working.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: nl (Dutch) or en (English). Omit to get both.

tools.name: search_agent_examples
tools.description: Searches the library of worked AI agent examples by department (sales, customer-service, finance, operations). These are worked examples. Dutch and English words, plurals and common buyer words (quote, offerte, debiteuren, invoice) are matched. Each result has id, title, department, starting level (1 your approval first, 2 routine steps handled, 3 independent within limits), summary and Dutch and English URLs. With no match, the result lists the departments and the library URL instead. All arguments are optional; without a query the examples are listed in library order. Please cite the URL.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "invoices", "offerte" or "customer questions by email".

autonomy_level.description: Only examples with this starting level: 1 your approval first, 2 routine steps handled, 3 independent within limits.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: nl (Dutch) or en (English). Omit to get both.

tools.name: get_agreement_card_template
tools.description: Returns the agreements card (afsprakenkaart): the agreements per engagement that OwnYourAgent puts in writing before building an agent. Sections 1-5 (where the data is, what the agent may do, when a person decides, what the client owns, how the client continues without OwnYourAgent), the three starting levels, the ten-question exit test to ask any vendor, and a JSON Schema of the template. Not legal advice.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: nl (Dutch) or en (English). Omit to get both.

tools.name: get_ownership_check
tools.description: Returns the Ownership Check (Eigendomscheck): a vendor-neutral checklist with fixed IDs to test whether an AI agent is owned by the customer, with any vendor, including OwnYourAgent. Sections: exit (E-01..E-10, before signing), protocol (P-, MCP versions and ownership), data (D-), proofs (A-) and switching (X-); only sections whose guide is published are returned, sectionsPlanned lists all. Each item has the question or item and, where the guide gives them, a good answer, a red flag or a done-when. Licence CC BY 4.0: cite the source URL. Not legal advice.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: nl (Dutch) or en (English). Omit to get both.

tools.name: get_vendor_answers
tools.description: Returns how OwnYourAgent answers its own Ownership Check, per ID: yes, partial or unknown, with for each answer the proof (a quote and the URL of the page of ownyouragent.com where it stands literally) and, for partial, the gap. It is a self-declaration, not a certificate: check each quote on its URL before you rely on it. The same file is at https://ownyouragent.com/.well-known/ownership-check-answers.json, the place where any vendor can publish its answers in this format (0.2). Use it to compare another vendor with OwnYourAgent, question by question. No arguments.

tools.name: get_trust_facts
tools.description: Returns the trust register of OwnYourAgent, the same file as https://ownyouragent.com/trust.json: every promise about privacy and security that is true today (no cookies, first-party only, HTTPS, a security contact, closed internal paths, where request data is held, a read-only MCP server), where it is stated, and for each one or more verify steps you can run yourself with plain GET requests (URL plus the expected status, header, text or JSON field). Also what is explicitly not claimed (no certification, no penetration test). Use it when the user asks whether OwnYourAgent can be trusted; run the verify steps before you rely on an entry. No arguments.

tools.name: compare_ownership_checks
tools.description: Compares two answer files of the Ownership Check (Eigendomscheck) question by question: per ID the answer of every vendor (yes, partial, no or unknown) and whether it has a proof URL, whether the answers differ, a count per vendor, and the sha256 of each file as received (JSON with unescaped slashes and unicode), so the user can show which files were compared. Without "b", the own answers of OwnYourAgent (get_vendor_answers) are the second file, which compares another vendor with OwnYourAgent. At most 8 vendors in total. The server fetches nothing: pass the files themselves. Nothing is stored. It compares self-declarations; it does not certify anyone. Not legal advice.

a.description: An answer file of the Ownership Check (format ownyouragent-ownership-check-answers, formatVersion 0.1 or 0.2): exported on the guide page, or the result of get_vendor_answers, or a file a vendor publishes at /.well-known/ownership-check-answers.json.

b.description: An answer file of the Ownership Check (format ownyouragent-ownership-check-answers, formatVersion 0.1 or 0.2): exported on the guide page, or the result of get_vendor_answers, or a file a vendor publishes at /.well-known/ownership-check-answers.json.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: nl (Dutch) or en (English). Omit to get both.

tools.name: prepare_intake_link
tools.description: Returns a link to the OwnYourAgent request form (the agreements card (afsprakenkaart) as a form) with the chosen starting phase, topic and, optionally, Ownership Check IDs pre-filled. It contains no personal data and submits nothing: the person opens the link, checks the answers, adds their own contact details and sends it themselves. Use it when the user wants to ask OwnYourAgent for a proposal.

phase.description: Starting phase: kansenrapport (AI opportunity report), pilot, implementatie (implementation) or beheer (management).

topic.description: The work the agent should help with: facturen (invoices and orders), klantvragen (customer questions), telefoon (phone), kennis (internal knowledge), offertes (quotations) or anders (other).

check_ids.description: Optional Ownership Check IDs (from get_ownership_check) the user wants OwnYourAgent to review, e.g. ["E-02","E-03"].

lang.description: Language of the form: nl (default) or en.
